fields.location: Trench T-4, Marlow St at 4th Ave
fields.utility: Natural gas distribution main, 4 in plastic
fields.markedPosition: Marks 3 ft west of the line as found
fields.whatHappened: The excavator bucket cut the main while the crew exposed a sewer lateral. Gas escaped; the crew left the trench and the street was cleared 300 ft.
fields.actions: 911 called at 10:13. Engines and the utility crew on scene. Work stopped on the whole project until the utility releases the area.
